MIND. [1] [Caps.]
Coma and delirium. θ Typhus. θ Yellow fever.
Children become clumsy, awkward ; especially with headache.
Haunted by a disposition to suicide.
He is taciturn, peevish and obstinate.
He is in a contented mood, is jocose, and sings, and still he becomes angry from the slightest cause.
Homesickness : with red cheeks and sleeplessness ; with hot feeling in fauces.
Melancholy or hypochondriasis.
Fearfulness.
Awakens with fright, screams, and remains full of fear.
Obstinacy.
After emotions, fever, with red cheeks.
   

SENSORIUM. [2] [Caps.]
Vertigo : reeling from side to side ; with hypochondriasis and torpid digestion ; during cold stage of intermittent fever.
Senses obtuse.
   

INNER HEAD. [3] [Caps.]
Darting pains in head ; < at rest ; > walking.
Headache, as if skull would split, when moving head, walking, or coughing.
A bursting headache, or feeling as if brain was too full, or head too large.
Bursting pain and throbbing in head. θ Pertussis. θ Intermittent fever.
Headache as if skull was bruised, on moving head and on walking.
Throbbing headache in forehead and temples.
Pressing headache in forehead and temples.
Constant pressive headache in forehead, above root of nose, with stitches through ear and over eye.
Pressing headache in forehead, as though a pressure from occiput would force the brain out through forehead, accompanied by cutting pain coming forward from occiput.
Drawing tearing in left side of head.
A headache, more stitching than tearing ; < during rest ; > on motion.
Headache during chill. θ Intermittent.
Megrim and hysterical cephalalgia.
   

OUTER HEAD. [4] [Caps.]
Head seems too large.
Drawing, tearing pain in right frontal bone.
Skull feels bruised, on moving head, or walking.
Swelling on mastoid process behind ear, painful to contact.
Periostitis and caries of mastoid process.
   

SIGHT AND EYES. [5] [Caps.]
Burning in eyes, with redness and lachrymation.
Pressing pain in eyes, as from a foreign body.
Eyes protrude from sockets, with burning and lachrymation. θ Pertussis.
   

HEARING AND EARS. [6] [Caps.]
Cannot bear noise. θ Intermittent fever.
Dull hearing, after previous burning and stinging in ear.
Catarrhal deafness.
A pressive pain in ear with every cough, as if an abscess would open. θ Pertussis.
A pressive pain very deep in ears.
Pressive, later an itching pain, deep in ear.
Aching in one or both ears when coughing.
Itching pain very deep in ear. θ Otitis.
Tympanum perforated, and cavity filled with thick, yellow pus. θ Otitis.
Tearing in concha of ear.
Ears very hot. θ Pertussis.
Tearing pain behind left ear.
Swelling behind ear, painful to touch.
Painful swelling behind ear ; periostitis and caries of mastoid process.
Deep-seated swelling under ear. θ Otitis.
   

SMELL AND NOSE. [7] [Caps.]
Nosebleed in morning, in bed.
Bloody mucous discharge from nose, when coughing. θ Pertussis.
Collection of thick mucus in nose and throat. θ Scarlatina.
Stoppage of nose.
Crawling tickling in nose, as in stopped coryza.
Tingling, titillation in nose. θ Hoarseness. θ Coryza.
Sneezing, with roughness in throat. θ Scarlatina.
Tip of nose very hot and red, < towards evening. θ Pertussis.
   

UPPER FACE. [8] [Caps.]
Increased heat of face.
Cheeks red, not hot, alternating with paleness. θ Scarlatina. θ Intermittent.
Pain in face, < from touch and in evening. θ Prosopalgia.
Pain in face, partly like bone pains, excited by external touch ; partly like fine pains, piercing the nerves, which are tormenting on falling asleep.
Pressure in zygoma, < from touch and in evening.
Neuralgia facialis. θ Fothergill's disease.
   

LOWER FACE. [9] [Caps.]
Lips : swollen ; cracked ; smarting ; burning. θ Diarrhœa. θ Scarlatina.
Burning, painful vesicles in mouth. θ Cancrum oris.
   

TEETH AND GUMS. [10] [Caps.]
Teeth dirty and painful. θ Stomatitis.
Gums : hot, burning, swollen, inflamed and sensitive ; spongy, retracted from teeth. θ Stomatitis.
   

TASTE, SPEECH, TONGUE. [11] [Caps.]
Taste : sour ; flat, watery, followed by heartburn ; foul, like putrid water. θ Diarrhœa. θ Intermittent. θ Dysentery.
When coughing, the air from lungs causes a strange, offensive taste in mouth.
Small burning blisters on tongue. θ Scarlatina.
Tongue and inside of lips full of flat, sensitive, spreading ulcers, with a lardaceous centre. θ Stomatitis.
   

INNER MOUTH. [12] [Caps.]
Fetid odor, unbearable, carrion-like. θ Stomacace.
Saliva : viscid, offensive, copious. θ Stomatitis. θ Scarlatina.
Salivation during chill. θ Intermittent.
Burning blisters in mouth. θ Scarlatina.
Small, flat, burning ulcers in mouth and fauces.
Tough mucus in mouth, or dryness.
   

PALATE AND THROAT. [13] [Caps.]
Burning soreness with ulcers on fauces. θ Angina faucium.
Painful pressure in hard and soft palate while swallowing. θ Scarlatina. θ Angina aphthosa.
Tough congealed mucus in posterior nares, on rising in morning, requiring much hawking to dislodge.
Uvula elongated, feels as if pressing on something hard.
Continuous stitches in throat, exciting dry, convulsive cough. θ Pertussis.
Stinging, causing night cough.
Continued stitching in throat, in region of epiglottis, causing a dry cough without relief.
Tonsillitis with burning, smarting pain.
Left tonsil inflamed ; right painful. θ Asthma.
Great soreness in throat, with smarting. θ Scarlatina.
Spasmodic contraction of throat. θ Angina faucium.
Constriction of throat, with burning ; whitish deposit. θ Scarlatina. θ Diphtheria.
Burning and other pains in throat < between acts of deglutition.
Pain in throat, only when coughing, as from a single swelling.
Pressive pain in throat, as if an abscess would break, during a paroxysm of coughing. θ Pertussis.
Throat inflamed, dark red, burning, pressing.
Whitish spots in throat, with a red halo.
Inflammation of throat, dark purplish-red color of velum palati, right side, near eustachian tube, with most violent pains, causing anxiety ; salivation and thirst for cold water ; heat, with shuddering and cold finger-tips ; pulse unchanged ; < in morning and towards evening.
Relaxed sore throat with cough ; subacute inflammation of throat, with dryness and smarting ; relaxed uvula of smokers and drinkers.
Pain on swallowing, as in inflammation of throat, but when not swallowing, drawing pain in throat.
Difficulty in swallowing, tongue furred ; haggard look.
Dysphagia paralytica.
Torpidity of fauces, pharynx and œsophagus.
Aphthous angina.
Tonsillitis.
Angina pharyngea maligna, gangrenosa.
Deposits covering a considerable portion of fauces, with smarting. θ Diphtheria.
In scarlatinal anginas with redness of face as in tipplers, small red spots in face, burning vesicles in mouth and on tongue.
   

APPETITE, THIRST. DESIRES, AVERSIONS. [14] [Caps.]
Appetite increased, alternating with aversion to food and complete anorexia.
Thirstlessness, or intense thirst with abdominal uneasiness, but no tenderness on pressure.
Thirst, during fever only, for large quantities.
Thirstily, as the chill comes on. θ Intermittent.
Thirst after stool. θ Dysentery.
Desire for coffee, but it nauseates. θ Diarrhœa.
Dipsomania ; morning vomiting, sinking at stomach.
   

EATING AND DRINKING. [15] [Caps.]
Food tastes sour. θ Diarrhœa.
Better while eating ; < after.
After eating : burning in stomach.
Vegetables cause flatulence.
Nausea, and attacks of suffocation, after coffee, yet desire for it.
   

HICCOUGH, BELCHING, NAUSEA AND VOMITING. [16] [Caps.]
Belching, with stitch in side, while walking.
Heartburn ; waterbrash. θ Catarrh of stomach.
Nausea and vomiting, with headache.
Nervous, spasmodic vomiting.
Vomits phlegm, with chill. θ Intermittent.
Vomiting in malignant fevers. θ Yellow fever.
   

SCROBICULUM AND STOMACH. [17] [Caps.]
Pressing pain in scrobiculum.
Stitches in scrobiculum on breathing deeply, from talking and from touch.
Accumulation of mucus and acids in stomach.
Burning in stomach. θ Gastralgia. θ Colic.
Sensitiveness and aching in region of stomach and duodenum after colic. θ Dysentery.
Stomach icy cold, or burning in it.
Deranged stomach, with fever.
Dyspepsia from torpidity, particularly in old people.
Gastralgia and gastromalacia.
   

HYPOCHONDRIA. [18] [Caps.]
"Catching" pain in region of liver, or in lower portion of right lung, with each cough. θ Pleuro-pneumonia.
Spleen sensitive, swollen, especially after abuse of quinine.
Painful enlargement of spleen. θ Intermittent.
   

ABDOMEN AND LOINS. [19] [Caps.]
Burning or cutting pains in abdomen. θ Hemorrhoids.
Drawing and twisting in abdomen, with and without diarrhœa.
Peculiar feeling in abdomen, a sort of drawing ; he must bend double.
Colic, with cutting-twisting pain about navel, and passage of tough mucus, like diarrhœa, at times mixed with black blood ; after every stool, thirst, and after every drink, shivering.
Flatulence and wind-colic.
Abdomen distended to bursting. θ Dysentery.
Sore pains in abdomen and loins.
A tensive pain, extending from abdomen to chest, as from distension in abdomen ; cannot bear clothing.
A pressive tension in abdomen, especially in epigastric region, between pit of stomach and navel, < on motion, together with a pressive tension in lower portion of back.
Abdomen distended ; suffocative arrest of breathing. θ Dysentery. θ Cystitis.
   

STOOLS AND RECTUM. [20] [Caps.]
Stools : frequent, small, with tenesmus and burning in rectum and bladder ; bloody, mucous, shaggy ; greenish, frothy, < at night ; tenacious mucus, mixed with black blood.
Mucous diarrhœa with tenesmus.
Dysentery : tenesmus and strangury ; pain < from a current of air, even if warm.
After a drink, must go to stool, but was costive ; only a little mucus passed.
After stool :tenesmus ; burning at anus ; thirst, drinking causes shuddering ; drawing pains in back.
Smarting and burning pain in anus and rectum. θ Diarrhœa. θ Dysentery.
Biting-stinging pain in anus, with diarrhœa-like stool.
Violent tenesmus. θ Dysentery.
Tenesmus of rectum and bladder at same time.
Hemorrhoids : burning as if pepper was sprinkled on them, swollen, itching, throbbing ; with sore feeling in anus ; bleeding or blind ; with mucous discharge ; with bloody, mucous stools ; with drawing pain in small of back and cutting pain in abdomen.
Suppressed hemorrhoidal flow, causing melancholy.
   

URINARY ORGANS. [21] [Caps.]
Renal pains, with or without calculi. θ Nephritis.
Burning in bladder. θ Dysentery. θ Gonorrhœa.
Colic, with spasm of bladder.
Burning in orifice of urethra, immediately before, during, and for a minute after urinating.
Stitches, as with needles, in forepart of urethra, when not urinating.
Pressure towards bladder, and some stitches extending from within outward in region of neck of bladder, while coughing, and some time afterwards.
Tenesmus vesicæ ; strangury. θ Dysentery.
Frequent, unsuccessful desire to urinate. θ Diarrhœa.
Frequent micturition, scalding, smarting, sticking pain in urethra, tenesmus and even chordee ; (as inflammation subsides discharge less and thinner). θ Gonorrhœa.
Burning, smarting after urination.
Burning-biting pain in urethra, after urinating.
Retention of urine, spasm of bladder. θ Cystitis, in horses.
Inflammation of neck of bladder. θ Cystitis.
Purulent discharge from urethra, sometimes bleeding. θ Gonorrhœa.
   

MALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [22] [Caps.]
Painful erections at night ; cream-like discharge from urethra ; burning, when urinating ; at other times cutting, stinging in urethra.
Discharge from urethra : purulent ; bloody, urethra painful to touch ; cream-like.
Gonorrhœa : second stage ; white discharge, like cream ; excessive sensibility of parts to contact ; chordee, which can only be appeased or subdued in cold water.
Protracted gleet.
Coldness of scrotum, and impotence ; dwindling of testicles and extinction of sexual instinct ; shrivelling of spermatic cords ; emaciation ; falling off of beard and weakness of sight.
Prepuce swollen.
Crampy, testicular pains after emissions.
Pain in prostate gland. θ Gonorrhœa.
Coldness of scrotum, in morning on walking.
   

FEMALE SEXUAL ORGANS. [23] [Caps.]
During menstruation : nausea ; pressure in epigastrium.
Disordered menstruation, with a pushing or sticking sensation in left ovarian region.
   

PREGNANCY. PARTURITION. LACTATION. [24] [Caps.]
During pregnancy : affections of ears ; heartburn, vomiting ; mucous diarrhœa ; hemorrhoids ; burning in anus.
   

VOICE AND LARYNX. TRACHEA AND BRONCHIA. [25] [Caps.]
Hoarseness from straining voice, in singers, preachers, etc.
Hoarseness, nose stopped up, throat feels rough. θ Scarlatina.
Excessive tingling and tickling in larynx, < after lying down, in evening. θ Pertussis.
Crawling and tickling in larynx and trachea, with a dry, hacking cough, in evening, after lying down.
Chronic sore throat. θ Bronchitis maligna.
   

RESPIRATION. [26] [Caps.]
Exhalation from lungs, on coughing, causes a strong offensive taste in mouth.
Seems as if she could not get air deep enough into lungs.
Deep breathing, almost like a sigh. θ Pertussis.
Respiration slow.
Asthma : with red face, eructations, chest feels distended ; wheezing inspiration ; breathing < when moving about, ascending or walking.
Sibilant rales mostly left side posteriorly, during inspiration ; spongy sound during expiration ; constant dyspnœa ; oppression at bifurcation of bronchia, > from successful cough. θ Asthma.
Dyspnœa, which seems to rise from stomach, or from fulness of chest.
   

COUGH. [27] [Caps.]
Painful cough.
Frequent dry, hacking cough.
Dry, hard evening cough, with pain in distant parts.
Evening and night cough, with hectic.
Nervous, spasmodic cough.
Cough in sudden paroxysms, convulses whole body.
Cough, with headache, as if head would fly to pieces.
Cries after coughing. θ Whooping cough.
With every explosive cough (and at no other time) there escape a volume of pungent, fetid air. θ Pleuro-pneumonia.
Coughing or sneezing causes a sudden pain in one or other of limbs.
Cough, with drawing from chest into neck.
Cough, with feeling of pulling upward from stomach, up chest to throat pit.
Stitches in suffering parts, with cough.
Cough < : after anger ; after warm drinks ; evening, night ; when lying ; after sharp winds ; dry, cold weather ; any draught, warm or cold.
Sputa dirty brown, not rusty. θ Pleuro-pneumonia.
   

INNER CHEST AND LUNGS. [28] [Caps.]
Pain in chest and back ; during heat. θ Intermittent.
Drawing in one or both sides of chest, up to neck. θ Pertussis.
Throbbing pain in chest.
Pain in chest when sitting, as if chest was too full and there was not room enough in it.
Pain as if chest was constricted, which arrests breathing and is < even on slight motion.
Pleuritic pains. θ Quotidian intermittent.
   

HEART, PULSE AND CIRCULATION. [29] [Caps.]
Pulse : irregular, often intermittent ; slow, intermitting.
Pulse full, strong, most frequent in evening. θ Dysentery.
   

OUTER CHEST. [30] [Caps.]
Pains in sternum, with sweat, while walking.
   

NECK AND BACK. [31] [Caps.]
Jerking-tearing pain in right cervical glands.
Glands of neck painful, swollen. θ Stomatitis.
Excruciating, tearing pains in back, extorting cries, cause him to double up, during chill. θ Intermittent.
Drawing-tearing pain in back and spine.
Shooting in back and chest. θ Cough.
Pain in sacrum and small of back. θ Hemorrhoids. θ Dysentery.
Pain in back continuing after stool. θ Diarrhœa.
Chilliness between scapulæ. θ Asthma.
Coldness beginning in back. θ Intermittent.
Sensation as if cold water was dropping down back. θ Intermittent.
   

UPPER LIMBS. [32] [Caps.]
Drawing-tearing pain in arms.
   

LOWER LIMBS. [33] [Caps.]
Shooting-tearing from hip to knee and foot, especially when coughing.
Sticking-tearing pain from hip joints to feet, especially on coughing.
Drawing pain in hip joint (pain like a stiff neck), < from touch and bending trunk backward.
Caries of right hip ; left leg atrophied and painful.
Tensive pain in knee.
Cold sweat on upper part of legs.
Cold feet.
Violent pains in left atrophic leg. θ Spinal curvature, with coxarthrocace.
   

LIMBS IN GENERAL. [34] [Caps.]
Rheumatic pain in limbs. θ Cough.
Tearing in limbs ; they are drawn up during chill. θ Intermittent.
   

NERVES. [36] [Caps.]
Great restlessness. θ Measles.
Lack of reactive force, especially with fat people.
Great desire to lie down and sleep ; does not want to exert himself in the least. θ Angina faucium. θ Diphtheria.
Weak, exhausted ; vital forces sunken. θ Paralysis. θ Gangrene. θ Meteorism. θ Typhus.
Staggering when walking.
   

SLEEP. [37] [Caps.]
Yawning. θ Diarrhœa.
Constant desire to lie down and sleep. θ Sore throat.
Sleepless from emotions, from homesickness, or from cough.
Screaming in sleep. θ Pertussis.
Sleep full of dreams, restless. θ Pertussis.
   

FEVER. [40] [Caps.]
Fever heat, with violent burning and headache.
Absence of thirst during heat. θ Intermittent.
Heat, followed by chill, with thirst.
Heat lessened by motion.
Fever at 11 A. M. (following chill at 10.30 A. M.), lasting all night, with great thirst.
Skin cool, pulse slow, want of appetite. θ Dysentery.
Coldness over whole body ; limbs are cold without shivering.
Shivering and chilliness after every drink.
Chilly externally ; inwardly, burning.
Chill begins in back, with thirst, < after drinking, lessened when walking out of doors.
Chilly on moving.
Chill at 10.30 A. M., commencing between shoulders and running down back.
Chill in open air, particularly in a draught.
Thirst just before and during chill.
During chill, cold across chest, with a sensation as of water dropping down back.
Sweat : violent, copious ; lessened by motion.
Sweat coming on soon after fever commences, and continuing with it.
Profuse sweat after fever, all night.
Intermittent, with torpidity of abdominal nervous centres and painful enlargement of spleen.
Hectic fever after emotions, and in nostalgia.
   

ATTACKS, PERIODICITY. [41] [Caps.]
Chill spreads gradually until extreme points are reached, then as gradually declines. θ Intermittent.
   

SENSATIONS. [43] [Caps.]
As if Cayenne pepper was sprinkled on parts.
Violent pains on various places ; now here, now there. θ Neuralgia of children.
Sensation as if parts would go to sleep.
   

TISSUES. [44] [Caps.]
Relaxed fibre : obesity.
Joints : crack ; stiff, painful on beginning to move ; pain, as if paralyzed.
Marasmus.
Intermittent fever.
   

TOUCH. PASSIVE MOTION. INJURIES. [45] [Caps.]
Worse from touch ; skin sensitive, with many internal ailments.
Seasickness.
   

SKIN. [46] [Caps.]
Burning in skin.
Skin bloated, flabby.
Itching < from scratching.
Scarlet eruption on neck and breast, face of extreme redness, sometimes alternating with a mottled appearance ; lips swollen and cracked, burning blisters in mouth and on tongue ; saliva very slimy and little increased in quantity ; tickling and roughness in throat, with sneezing and a hacking cough. θ Scarlatina.
Herpetic-like eruption on forehead, on face itching-burning.
   

STAGE OF LIFE, CONSTITUTION. [47] [Caps.]
Light hair, blue eyes.
Frequently indicated in persons of lax fibre and muscles, less frequently in those of tense fibre.
Nervous, but full habit.
Phlegmatic, awkward, easily offended ; indolent, melancholic ; lack of reaction. θ Gastric troubles.
Lazy, fat, unclean persons who dread open air.
Children who are always chilly, refractory, clumsy.
Gouty individuals.
Hemorrhoidal constitutions.
